verdict.rationale: Jira's docs claim automation via Rovo AI (custom automations, reminders, rules that move work forward, auto-assigning tasks) which supports background autonomous automation, but this is vendor-only marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability or true autonomy, and community evidence focuses on general UX complaints rather than automation specifically. missing for 10: independent verification that Rovo AI automations run reliably and autonomously, technical documentation of automation rule engine/triggers, community confirmation of background automation use.
